cohort: All first-rank selected programs from round 8 with prepared expected slots; 16 trials. N01 has no typed slot.
hypotheses: Structured semantic values prevent source quoting mistakes.
Mask constant locals used solely as oracle operands/diagnostics to remove a remaining old-value cue.
Keep noneditable relational expressions fixed instead of offering impossible edits.
High reasoning effort with 16384 output tokens may improve derivation compared with the earlier disabled 4096 setting.
baseline: Round 8 first-rank raw disabled responses, recorded before this experiment. No outcome or evaluation labels are sent.
causal_limit: Value arm bundles codec, oracle-local masking, and fixed relational-expression handling. Do not attribute a difference to one of these alone.
tests: 15 focused tests passed across operand immutability, masking role boundaries, literal encoding, and interface normalization.
normalization: Accept echoed source_reference only when byte-identical to the fixed old reference; preserve original decisions and reject mismatching references. No provider responses rerun.
findings: N05 stale local expected constant was corrected by raw high-reasoning and both masked-value arms; the old disabled raw arm copied the stale constant.

Structured disabled derivations returned more structurally acceptable programs, but this is not semantic validity. Raw enabled identified inapplicable N04, N10 and P7 programs; type analysis independently contradicted the N10 and P7 setups.
Four enabled structured responses echoed an exact source_reference field and were rejected by the original codec. A checked metadata normalization recovers them.
Finite-length failures and one invalid kind=false response remain unknown.
decision: Retain value-interface and constant-mask components for another full pipeline trial. Do not claim better detection or precision from component acceptance counts.
